chunks: From him, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from al-Harith ibn al-Mughirah, from Umar ibn Hanzalah, who said:

I was gauging the sun in the presence of Abu Abdillah عليه السلام, and he said: “O Umar, shall I not inform you of something clearer than this?” He said: I said, “Yes, may I be made your ransom.” He said: “When the sun declines, then the time of Zuhr has begun, except that before it there is a supererogatory prayer, and that is up to you. So if you make your supererogatory prayer light, then it is when you finish your supererogatory prayer; and if you lengthen it, then it is when you finish your supererogatory prayer.”

key_terms.خَفَّفْتَ: you made it brief or light
key_terms.زَالَتِ: it declined from the middle of the sky
key_terms.سُبْحَةً: a supererogatory prayer before the obligatory prayer

ai.seo_question: When does the time of Zuhr prayer begin according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the beginning of the time of Zuhr prayer as the sun’s decline from the meridian. It also indicates that a supererogatory prayer may be performed at that point, and its length depends on the worshipper’s choice.
